description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named PimDefinedReportSearchFilterParams, which extends a base FilterParams class. It is used to encapsulate search filter parameters related to displaying or querying custom reports within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for filtering by report name and report ID. The class includes constants, protected properties, constructor initialization, and getter/setter methods for its attributes.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering search parameters related to Pim-defined reports, including report name and report ID, with a predefined sort field.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the report name filter parameter if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the report name filter parameter.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Returns the report ID filter parameter if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setReportId
methods.description: Sets the report ID filter parameter.
